title: Becas Internas Postdoctorales (Convocatoria 2026)
institution: Consejo Nacional de Investigaciones Científicas y Técnicas (CONICET)
about: CONICET's internal postdoctoral fellowships (Convocatoria 2026) offer 800 three-year fellowships in Argentina starting 1 August 2027. Applications run 18 February to 5 March 2027, with closing dates staggered by national ID number.
requirements: Only applicants who have submitted the final copies of their doctoral thesis or defended it at the time of application
Electronic submission 18 February - 5 March 2027, staggered by the last digit of the national ID (DNI); DNI ending in 0 closes 1 March
800 postdoctoral fellowships; 70% for projects in Priority Topics and priority regions/areas
Fellowships start from 1 August 2027 and last 36 months

upskill.name: EduCut AI Academy catalog
why: Shortlist top scores (A004.07, A005.15) rest on incidental terms ("project", "final", "electronic"); no course objective covers "Only applicants who have submitted the final copies of their doctoral thesis or defended it" or a specific discipline, since the field is "All scientific and technological disciplines".
Field "All scientific and technological disciplines" → catalog spans all Academies, so applicants can choose AI skills relevant to their own research area.
